title: every asset, link and event carries a class and a source reference (nodes, events, possession periods, breaks, trade legs, cap entries, transfers, departures, points, contracts)
every trade in the bundle equals its raw archive rows or snapshot entry, checked by a separate code path
every transaction keeps its date, time, date quality, asset identity and both franchise ids
every chain replays the recorded trades; every discontinuity is listed, none is filled
every slot comes from an MFL slot token and the MFL draft result for that slot; a future pick is never confirmed to a slot

uniqueness infers only when the holder owns one slot AND the round's inventory is demonstrably complete AND custody is observed to the evidence date (INFERRED, labeled); two slots, an incomplete or disagreeing inventory, an unobserved period or no evidence stay UNRESOLVED
no owner field or owner name anywhere; every statement is about a franchise id
possession periods come from trade, draft and add or drop events; weekly-roster disagreements are listed, not used

the build fails if the extraction reads any ranking or forecast data (draft slots come only from MFL draft results, slot tokens and slot lists): the runtime table guard and the static source scan are both clean
points are per franchise and per possession, copy weeks are excluded, disputed weeks are not verified, and an INFERRED asset never enters a confirmed-only total
every salary and contract shown equals the recorded weekly roster row; none is estimated; team cap totals are explicitly not computed
the trace stops at the stated generation limit and every untraced continuation is listed on the frontier

the 2025-11-28 to 2026-03-07 trade-coverage gap is on the list and is shown on every chain (player or pick) that crosses it; no pick whose custody crosses it is resolved; every chain break is a listed gap
two builds are byte-identical and match the committed bundle; the archive opens read-only; no extraction module contains a network call pattern (fetch, http, net, WebSocket)
only franchise ids, team names and player names appear; no owner column is read; no email, credential or chat text
